title: ExpressiveScore
description: The compiled, exact-time performance of a NagmaDoc at a specific BPM and Sa, expanded across a super-loop of N avartans with per-avartan expressive variation baked in. This is what the render package consumes. INVARIANT: matra boundaries and sam are mathematically exact; micro-timing jitter is applied only to non-structural notes.

sa_midi.description: MIDI note number the Sa (tonic) maps to.

avartans.description: Number of cycles in the rendered super-loop.

loop_length_samples.description: round(loop_length_s * sample_rate). The render MUST be trimmed/padded to exactly this many frames for gapless looping. This is the primary correctness gate.

seed.description: Base RNG seed; avartan a uses seed derived from this so the super-loop isn't rubber-stamped.

bellows.description: Slow amplitude undulation applied as a post-render gain LFO (harmonium bellows breathing).

events.description: All note events across the super-loop, sorted by start_s.

start_s.description: Onset in seconds from loop start. For structural notes this is exact (no jitter).

dur_s.description: Sounding duration including legato overlap into the next note.

avartan.description: Which cycle of the super-loop this event belongs to.

structural.description: True if this note lands on a matra boundary (no timing jitter applied).

swell.description: Intra-note bellows swell depth (Phase B). The note begins at (1-swell) of full expression and rises to full over its attack, modeling a harmonium player's bellows building pressure. 0 = flat/held. Rendered as CC11 automation.
